key_concepts: Biotechnology has applications in different fields.
Biotechnologies can be traditional or modern.
Genetic fingerprinting involves cross-matching two strands of DNA.
Genetic fingerprinting is used in criminal investigation.
Genetic fingerprinting can have disadvantages such as mistaken identity.
Biotechnology is important in making investigations easier.
Fingerprint comparison can help identify a suspected criminal.
Biotechnology can be harmful or dangerous.
